    Behind the scenes

    • The painting is one flat picture, hung up behind everything. Nothing in it is 3D.
    • The painter's camera. The 3D camera sits where the painter "stood", so 3D things line up with the brush strokes.
    • The walkmesh is an invisible floor traced over the cobbles in front of the stall. Quill stands behind the counter, on floor the painting never shows.
    • Cut-outs are pieces of the painting stood up at their own depth. The counter is one: it hides Quill below the belt, and the lantern and the lavender hide her when she walks behind them.

    Drag to look around, scroll or pinch to zoom. You can keep walking with the keys.
